```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(fs)
library(glue)
library(here)
library(patchwork)
library(scico)
library(tidytext)
library(tidyverse)

source(here("case_studies", "src", "R", "visualize.R"))

base <- path(here("case_studies", "mnist_resnet"))
results_dir <- base / "results"
importance_dir <- results_dir / "importance"
fig_dir <- results_dir / "figures"
dir_create(fig_dir)

theme_set(theme_axiomatic(base_size = 11))

method_labels <- c(
    shap = "SHAP",
    integrated_gradients = "Int. Gradients",
    local_ttest = "Local t-test"
)
```

```{r load-data}
# Read sample metadata
sample_meta <- read_csv(results_dir / "sample_meta.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Pixel → (row, col) map
pixel_map <- read_csv(
    importance_dir / "pixel_feature_map.csv",
    show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Read attribution files for all methods
methods_local <- c("shap", "integrated_gradients", "local_ttest")
read_attributions <- function(method) {
    read_csv(
        importance_dir / glue("{method}_attributions.csv"),
        show_col_types = FALSE
    ) |>
        mutate(method = method)
}

all_attr <- map_dfr(methods_local, read_attributions)

# Pivot to long: one row per (instance, pixel, method)
pixel_cols <- paste0("pixel_", 0:783)

all_long <- all_attr |>
    select(sample_index, true_label, predicted_label, correct, method, all_of(pixel_cols)) |>
    pivot_longer(
        all_of(pixel_cols),
        names_to = "pixel_col",
        values_to = "attribution"
    ) |>
    mutate(pixel_index = as.numeric(str_replace(pixel_col, "pixel_", "")))

# Map pixel index to (row, col)
all_long <- all_long |>
    left_join(pixel_map, by = "pixel_index")

# normalize the attributions
all_long <- all_long |>
    group_by(method) |>
    mutate(attribution_z = as.numeric(scale(attribution))) |>
    ungroup()

# original images to place near attributions
raw_pixels <- read_csv(
    importance_dir / "raw_pixels.csv",
    show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
    select(sample_index, true_label, predicted_label, correct, all_of(pixel_cols)) |>
    pivot_longer(
        all_of(pixel_cols),
        names_to = "pixel_col",
        values_to = "intensity"
    ) |>
    mutate(pixel_index = as.numeric(str_replace(pixel_col, "pixel_", ""))) |>
    left_join(pixel_map, by = "pixel_index")
```

```{r digit-heatmap-fn}
#' Pixel-level attribution heatmap for one digit class.
#' @param digit true label to show (0-9)
plot_digit_heatmap <- function(digit) {
    show_instances <- sample_meta |>
        filter(true_label == digit) |>
        slice(1, 6, 7) |> # one correct, two different misclassifications
        pull(sample_index)

    instance_labels <- sample_meta |>
        filter(sample_index %in% show_instances) |>
        mutate(label = ifelse(correct,
            glue("sample {sample_index}: correct"),
            glue("sample {sample_index}: misclass → {predicted_label}")
        )) |>
        select(sample_index, label)

    attr_methods <- all_long |>
        filter(sample_index %in% show_instances, true_label == digit) |>
        left_join(instance_labels, by = "sample_index") |>
        mutate(method = recode(method, !!!method_labels))

    digit_images <- raw_pixels |>
        filter(sample_index %in% show_instances, true_label == digit) |>
        left_join(instance_labels, by = "sample_index") |>
        mutate(panel = "Original digit")

    p_image <- ggplot(digit_images, aes(x = col, y = row, fill = intensity)) +
        geom_tile() +
        scale_y_reverse() +
        scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "black", guide = "none") +
        coord_fixed() +
        facet_grid(panel ~ label) +
        theme_void() +
        theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 7))

    p_attr <- ggplot(attr_methods, aes(x = col, y = row, fill = attribution_z)) +
        geom_tile() +
        scale_y_reverse() +
        scale_fill_gradientn(
            colours = axiom_palette$diverging,
            name = "Attribution (z-score, clipped to ±4)",
            limits = c(-4, 4), oob = scales::squish # clip extreme values
        ) +
        coord_fixed() +
        facet_grid(method ~ label) +
        theme_void() +
        theme(
            strip.text.x = element_blank(),
            strip.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
            legend.position = "bottom",
            legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm")
        )

    n_methods <- length(unique(attr_methods$method))
    (p_image / p_attr) +
        plot_layout(heights = c(1, n_methods)) +
        plot_annotation(
            title = glue("Pixel-Level Attributions for Selected Digit {digit} Instances")
        )
}
```

```{r attribution-heatmaps-all-digits, results='asis', fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
for (digit in 0:9) {
    cat(glue("\n\n## Digit {digit}\n\n"))
    p_heatmap <- plot_digit_heatmap(digit)
    print(p_heatmap)
    ggsave(
        path(fig_dir, glue("fig_attribution_heatmap_digit{digit}.svg")),
        p_heatmap,
        width = 12, height = 6
    )
}
```
